instruction: You are in a room, facing towards the shelf, turn left, walk straight, towards your left there are shirts, walk straight, exit the room, slightly turn left and go near the table, walk few steps forward, towards you right there is an open door, go near the door and walk straight towards the switches which are in front of you, walk towards the sofa which is again in front of you, from there turn right and enter in to the room, walk two steps forward from the door, towards your right there is a candle stand, this would be your destination.
